step.cmd: In FTS, determine the CT for each client:

ul.li: If it is an initial or renewal claim, return to the previous task to update the entitlement weeks.
If it is a continuing claim, go to step 2.

step.cmd: For each client, determine if the claim status (CS) is 8 - Converted to Manual Pay :
Determine if there is an outstanding registration number related to the benefit-sharing agreement on file:

ul.li:
If no, select the Registration Number (M025,M030,M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction and for each client, create an Operational Center Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “The client is entitled to [XX] weeks — change the number of weeks from [XX] to [XX].”
Remarks line 2: Enter your first name and last name.

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Special benefits approved (3046): Select the appropriate option:
Family caregiver benefits for children approved
Start Date FCBC - Sunday’s date (11272): Enter the appropriate date.
Number of FCBC week(s) to be paid (11274): Enter the appropriate number of weeks.
Family caregiver benefits for adults approved
Start date FCBA - Sunday’s date (11268): Enter the appropriate date.
Number of FCBA week(s) to be paid (11270): Enter the appropriate number of weeks.
Right to request a reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to request a reconsideration .

step.cmd: In FTS, determine if the BT is 20 - Family caregiver for children or 21 - Family caregiver for adults:
In FTS, select Entitlement (M112) to access the Caregiver / Compassionate care entitlement (M112) screen and do the following:

ul.li: Start date: Leave this field blank.
End date: Leave this field blank.
Entitlement weeks: Leave this field blank.

step.cmd: On the Search for Caregiver / Compassionate care patient (MCB2) screen, determine if updating is required for another client:

ul.li: If the claim is an initial claim, go to step 11 of Determining if a claim is ready to be calculated — Family caregiver benefits . Determining if a claim is ready to be calculated — Family caregiver benefits
If the claim is a renewal or continuing claim, return to the previous task.
